+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _encode_input(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return base64.b64encode(data).decode("utf-8")
+
+
+def extract_receipt_fields(image_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"]
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        image_bytes = f.read()
+
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {
+                        "type": "input_text",
+                        "text": "Extract merchant, tax, total, and items from this receipt. Return strict JSON with keys merchant (string or null), tax (number or null), total (number or null), and items (array of objects with name, quantity, and price).",
+                    },
+                    {
+                        "type": "input_image",
+                        "image_url": f"data:image/png;base64,{_encode_input(image_bytes)}",
+                    },
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "text": {"format": {"type": "json_object"}},
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        data=json.dumps(payload),
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    output_text: Optional[str] = None
+    for item in data.get("output", []):
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                output_text = content.get("text")
+                if output_text:
+                    break
+        if output_text:
+            break
+
+    if not output_text:
+        raise ValueError("No structured response content returned by OpenAI API")
+
+    return json.loads(output_text)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: python extract_receipt_fields.py <receipt_image_path>")
+    result = extract_receipt_fields(sys.argv[1])
+    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+VENDOR_API_HOST = "https://api.veryfi.com"
+
+
+def _auth_headers() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    client_id = os.environ.get("VERYFI_CLIENT_ID", "")
+    username = os.environ.get("VERYFI_USERNAME", "")
+    api_key = os.environ.get("VERYFI_API_KEY", "")
+    if not client_id or not username or not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("VERYFI_CLIENT_ID, VERYFI_USERNAME, and VERYFI_API_KEY are required")
+    return {
+        "CLIENT-ID": client_id,
+        "AUTHORIZATION": f"apikey {username}:{api_key}",
+    }
+
+
+def _normalize_line_items(items: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    if not isinstance(items, list):
+        return []
+    normalized = []
+    for item in items:
+        if isinstance(item, dict):
+            normalized.append(
+                {
+                    "description": item.get("description") or item.get("name") or item.get("item"),
+                    "quantity": item.get("quantity"),
+                    "unit_price": item.get("unit_price") or item.get("price"),
+                    "amount": item.get("total") or item.get("amount") or item.get("line_total"),
+                }
+            )
+    return normalized
+
+
+def extract_invoice_fields(invoice_file_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    url = f"{VENDOR_API_HOST}/api/v8/partner/documents"
+    with open(invoice_file_path, "rb") as f:
+        response = requests.post(
+            url,
+            headers=_auth_headers(),
+            files={"file": f},
+            timeout=60,
+        )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    vendor = payload.get("vendor") or {}
+    date = payload.get("date") or payload.get("invoice_date")
+    total = payload.get("total") or payload.get("amount") or payload.get("total_amount")
+    line_items = _normalize_line_items(payload.get("line_items") or payload.get("items"))
+    return {
+        "vendor": vendor.get("name") if isinstance(vendor, dict) else vendor,
+        "date": date,
+        "total": total,
+        "line_items": line_items,
+        "raw": payload,
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import argparse
+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("invoice_file_path")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(extract_invoice_fields(args.invoice_file_path), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
